cohort: 73 women undergoing elective caesarean delivery under spinal anesthetic
finding: Administering 3IU of oxytocin during elective caesarean delivery resulted in non-inferior postpartum blood loss compared to the standard 5IU dosage, with a lower prevalence of vomiting but a potential need for slightly higher phenylephrine use to manage hypotension.
mod_finding: This study examined postpartum blood loss after elective cesarean deliveries and found no significant difference between women who received 3IU of oxytocin compared to those who received 5IU.
